name: qr-codes
description: PGA QR code package (@pgahq/qr-codes) and its Next.js playground.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pgahq/qr-codes && npm run build -w @pgahq/qr-codes && npm run typecheck -w @pgahq/qr-codes-playground
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pgahq/qr-codes && npm run dev -w @pgahq/qr-codes-playground
scripts.build:playground: npm run build -w @pgahq/qr-codes && npm run build -w @pgahq/qr-codes-playground
